question: Test whether the audited event receipts entail first odd half-stock arrival and persistent reciprocal shutoff.

objects.definition: recorded minus residual odd squared stock on a shared unit mode

sources.section_or_object_id: §6; §§7.1–7.3 D7.1/T7.2/T7.3/P7.4; concluding winding and event-time scope
sources.source_status: conditional receipt map and exact boundary identity

assumptions: Ordinary edge odd mode with Euclidean aligned direct record, positive conserved N, and independent even exchange.
v0.7 product lift keeps the real odd phase law out of the certified receipt fields; event address and time are supplied.
The continuous comparator is a declared reciprocal feedback law on the normalized odd balance.

technique_plan.technique: Fixed-receipt countermodels, rational stock replay and separable ODE
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: test timing and post-event kernel identifiability

clock_receipt.clock_type: dimensionless internal time; independently supplied finite event index
clock_receipt.residue_convention: zero completed cycles in the first quadrant
clock_receipt.update_rule: supplied receipt time held fixed in countermodels
clock_receipt.coupling: rate/phase law free in tested lift

dynamics_readout.state_space: ordinary odd source/record pair with independent even block
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: reciprocal q(B/N); compare continue and stop at receipt
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: positive source-only stock, zero record, closed exchange
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: norm stock preserved by each skew flow and identity state at event
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: zero shared coefficient cuts both odd directions

target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: 1536 affine receipt controls; three exact stock witnesses and exact analytic feedback
target_exposure.selection_criterion: match receipts while changing odd balance or post-event action
target_exposure.baseline: v0.7 product lift and v0.14 locally Lipschitz no-go

result.exact_expression: B=-48,0,+48 at N=50; comparator first hold at t=2/omega
result.scope: Identical receipts admit balances -48, 0 and 48 at the same event time under the audited product lift. Post-event hold is separately underdetermined. A continuous non-Lipschitz comparator holds at finite time.

counterexamples_and_failures: Same receipt and time do not determine odd phase in audited lift
Continuous but non-Lipschitz feedback can arrive at invariant stock balance in finite time
limitations: No sourced phase-locking or post-event operator update
No perturbation-resistant completion, Stage 2 selector, or physical correspondence
next_discriminant: Seek a sourced subcycle phase guard and a stock-preserving post-event change of the odd port kernel.
